query: SELECT pr.id, pr.status, pr.linkedFullPackageId, pr.totalPrice, fpo.id as fpo_id, fpo.orderType, fpo.status as fpo_status FROM purchaseRequests pr LEFT JOIN fullPackageOrders fpo ON pr.linkedFullPackageId = fpo.id ORDER BY pr.id DESC LIMIT 5;
